title: Simon vs. the Homo Sapiens Agenda
author: Becky Albertalli
summary: Sixteen-year-old Simon has been emailing an anonymous boy at his school. When a classmate finds the emails and uses them for leverage, Simon must handle his secret on someone else's terms.
readIf: you want a funny, warm, big-hearted teen romance about coming out and the awkward business of growing up.
skipIf: you want deep conflict or a more complex plot.

pairings.reason: An adult romcom with the same joyful, witty queer love story.
A quieter, more lyrical story of two boys coming to terms with who they are.
Another sweet, funny and very human high school romance.
